remarks: Lovely space for office/business/medical in the heart of Wilton town center. Other tenants in building include Smile Art Orthodontics, Fresh Green Light Driving School & a Wilton Center Chiropractor. With its central location, and current tenants, this space would be suitable for many types of local business users. Floor plan is very open and can be modified to suit your needs. Would be great for a yoga studio, tutoring, art, pottery, dance, martial arts, office or other service related businesses. Used to be a restaurant, and has a lovely front patio.    Rent $29 psf/yr plus approx. $4 psf/yr for pro rata utilities.   Minimal rental space is approx. 1820 SF, and additional contiguous space available for a total of approx. 2264 SF if desired.
